candidates.angle: Krishna gives this secret only because Arjuna is his friend and devotee
candidates.evidence: भक्तोऽसि मे सखा च (you are my devotee and my friend)

candidates.angle: The teaching is a supreme secret, kept hidden from the world
candidates.evidence: रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् (it is a supreme secret)

candidates.angle: The word ancient shows this is not a new teaching

angle_en: Friendship and devotion as the gateway
angle_hi: भक्ति और मित्रता इस ज्ञान का द्वार

en.intro: Krishna has just claimed that this teaching is ancient. Now he tells Arjuna exactly why he is hearing it. Listen to the reason.
en.notice: Krishna shares this supreme secret only with Arjuna because they share the bond of a devotee and a close friend. That relationship makes the hidden knowledge possible.
en.next: Arjuna now questions how an ancient teaching can come from a friend born recently.
en.meaning: Because you are my devotee and my friend, I have taught you today this ancient yoga. It is a supreme secret.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी कहा कि यह ज्ञान बहुत पुराना है। अब वे अर्जुन को बताते हैं कि वह इसे क्यों सुन रहा है। कारण सुनिए।
hi.meaning: तू मेरा भक्त और प्रिय सखा है, इसलिए मैंने आज तुझसे यही पुरातन योग कहा है, क्योंकि यह बड़ा उत्तम रहस्य है।
hi.notice: कृष्ण यह उत्तम रहस्य केवल अर्जुन को इसलिए बता रहे हैं क्योंकि वे भक्त और प्रिय मित्र हैं। यह रिश्ता, कोई पद नहीं, इस ज्ञान का द्वार है।
hi.next: अर्जुन अब पूछते हैं कि एक मित्र, जो हाल ही में पैदा हुआ है, प्राचीन काल में यह योग कैसे सिखा सकता है?

en.intro: Krishna has just claimed that this teaching is ancient. Now he tells Arjuna exactly why he is hearing it. Listen to the reason.
en.body: Because you are my devotee and my friend, I have taught you today this ancient yoga. It is a supreme secret. Krishna shares this supreme secret only with Arjuna because they share the bond of a devotee and a close friend. That relationship makes the hidden knowledge possible. Arjuna now questions how an ancient teaching can come from a friend born recently.
